answer: Keeping 56 aliases alive as a result means 56 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the zephyr quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the grove log reveals the live set and the spiral audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 173 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
